purpose: Single source of truth for what each product status means, what evidence it requires, and what the next action is. Read by validate-product-state.ps1 (forward gate) and by the agent when resolving the first unfinished stage, so two agents cannot invent two different orders.
settled_rule: A scaffold field counts as settled when it is present and is not PENDING, UNVERIFIED, UNKNOWN, DISCOVERY_PENDING, TBD or empty. Any value the agent deliberately writes -- including not_applicable -- counts as a decision.
